forum.title: Which ST board for prototyping STM32F415RG ?
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
You're using STM32F415RGT. So go to the STM32F415RG **Product Page**:

<https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32f415rg.html>

Look on the '**Tools & Software**' tab:

<https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32f415rg.html#tools-software>

And look under '**Product evaluation tools**' for available boards.

The [STM32F4DISCOVERY](https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stm32f4discovery.html "STM32F4DISCOVERY") is listed - it uses an STM32F407VG.

Downside of this board is that you have to [manually connect the ST-Link's Virtual COM Port](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus-products/virtual-com-port-in-stm32f407vgt6-discovery-board/m-p/720076/highlight/true#M260819) (VCP).

Alternatively, go to the **Nucleo Boards** product selector:

<https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stm32-nucleo-boards/products.html>

You can search by the microcontroller used; eg,

![AndrewNeil_0-1778575172143.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/23703edb-296d-4dee-f2dd-62186795b9fd.png "AndrewNeil_0-1778575172143.png")

See which one most closely matches the feature set that you'll actually be using ...

What ST board would you recommend? This is not really my realm. Thanks!
